name: Outbound Dialer & Campaigns
description: Center-initiated contact system: campaign list management, dialing modes paced to compliance ceilings, agent-assigned outcomes, and WFM-affecting schedule calendars.
roleInCenter: Outbound engine: reaches customers deliberately, inside regulatory windows, with auditable outcomes.

glossary.definition: Managed outreach effort with target list, offer or message, and success criteria
Pacing strategy that determines call placement rate and agent readiness model
Algorithm dials ahead of agent availability based on answer-rate prediction
Regulatory maximum share of answered-by-customer calls with no agent connected
Segmentation, DNC suppression, best-time filters, and penetration caps per record
Suppression regime: internal DNC plus registry checks before dial
Permitted contact hours by jurisdiction and consent type
Attempt reached the intended person; denominator for conversion metrics
Share of list records with a definitive outcome (contact, refusal, bad number)
Planned outbound volume events WFM must forecast for

children.name: Manual Preview
children.description: Agent reviews record and clicks to dial

children.name: Progressive
children.description: System dials one call per agent as they become available

children.name: Predictive
children.description: Paces ahead of availability; must respect abandoned ceiling

children.name: Voice Broadcast / Message Drop
children.description: No live agent; answer plays prerecorded message

children.name: Service Notification
children.description: Outage, delivery, fraud alerts with opt-out handling

children.name: DNC Suppression & Consent Basis
children.description: Reason recorded for each contact attempt

children.name: Opt-Out Handler
children.description: Immediate suppression and CRM consent write-back

metrics.name: Right-Party Contact Rate
metrics.definition: Attempts reaching intended party over dial attempts

metrics.name: Campaign Conversion
metrics.definition: Successful outcomes per right-party contact (sale, promise, saved customer)

metrics.name: Outbound Abandoned Share
metrics.definition: Customer-answered calls with no connected agent over ceiling baseline

metrics.name: Cost per Contact
metrics.definition: Fully loaded campaign cost over completed right-party contacts

metrics.name: Attempted Volume
metrics.definition: Total dial attempts in period; feeds inbound-after-outbound repeat wave forecasting

failureModes.name: Pacing Overrun
failureModes.signal: Abandon ceiling approached in specific intervals; regulator exposure grows
failureModes.mitigation: Auto-throttle and per-mode ceiling alarms in dialer config

failureModes.name: Consent Basis Gap
failureModes.signal: Audit finds contacts without recallable consent or business relationship
failureModes.mitigation: No dial without consent tag; CRM consent state is the gate

failureModes.name: Outbound Echo Wave
failureModes.signal: Inbound volume spikes 24-72h after campaign waves; WFM understaffed
failureModes.mitigation: Campaign calendar informs forecast; response-wave factor applied

failureModes.name: List Decay
failureModes.signal: Bad-number and wrong-party rates climbing as list ages
failureModes.mitigation: Penetration caps; auto-suspend records after N bad outcomes

exchanges: Consent and suppression states gate dialing
Attempt and outcome write-back to record
Campaign calendar as forecast event feed
Voice broadcast content and opt-out self-service paths
Outbound-specific compliance disclosures in evaluation rubric
